subject: Invoice & billing details for Redwood pilot - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@acme.com>, Accounts Payable <payables@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-15T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice & billing details for Redwood pilot - next steps

Hi Elena / AP team,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier — great to align on scope for the 6-week pilot. Per our discussion, I wanted to recap the procurement and billing items so we can get finance set up and avoid any delays when we start usage. Quick recap and asks: 

- Commercial path: Pilot will be billed monthly based on actual usage. Please confirm whether you will process via Purchase Order (PO) or pay-by-card.
- PO details: If you need a PO, can you confirm the required PO number format and the person who will approve?
- Net terms: Please confirm if net-30 is acceptable for this pilot. If you require different terms, flag here.
- Invoice format & recipient: Who should receive invoices (email)? Any specific header fields required (PO number, department code, tax ID)?
- Billing address / tax info: Please provide the billing address and VAT/GST or tax registration number you need on the invoice.
- Vendor onboarding: if you have a vendor onboarding / supplier form, please attach it (we can complete and return promptly).
- Marketplace: We support AWS Marketplace listing if procurement prefers transacting via marketplace. Is that of interest?

I've attached our pilot quote and a sample invoice template to show how we format PO, tax fields, and remittance instructions. If helpful, we can schedule a 15–20 minute billing ops call with Vivek and our finance team to walk through the vendor setup.

Next steps:
1) Elena/AP: confirm PO vs card, billing contact + email, billing address and tax/VAT ID, and any supplier onboarding docs.
2) Marissa/Vivek: prepare sample invoice with ACME details and confirm marketplace option.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_pilot_quote_20260515.pdf; sample_invoice_redwood.pdf
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <payables@acme.com>, ACME Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-05-16T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice & billing details for Redwood pilot - next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the note and the attachments. A few clarifications from AP / procurement: 

- Payment method: We prefer to process via PO for any new vendor. Credit card is okay for low-dollar one-offs, but for the pilot we will use a PO.
- PO numbering: Our standard PO format is ACME-PO-YYYY-NNNN (we'll issue one once vendor onboarding is complete).
- Net terms: Net 30 is standard and should be fine for the pilot.
- Invoice recipient: Please send invoices to payables@acme.com and cc procurement@acme.com. We also need the PO number printed in the invoice header and on each line item.
- Billing address & tax: Billing address for invoices is:
  ACME Corp
  Accounts Payable
  123 Innovation Way
  Palo Alto, CA 94301
  US
  Tax ID / EIN: 12-3456789

- Vendor onboarding: Attached is our vendor onboarding form (vendor_onboarding_form_ACME.pdf). Please complete and return. We also need a W-9 or equivalent tax document on file.

- Marketplace: Procurement prefers direct vendor contracts for now; marketplace transacting adds extra steps. If you can provide the standard vendor contract + W-9, we can expedite vendor setup and issue a PO.

If you want to hop on a short call with finance to speed this up, I can loop in our supplier setup coordinator.

Thanks,
Elena Ramos
Senior Procurement Manager, ACME Corp
elena.ramos@acme.com

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_ACME.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-16T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice & billing details for Redwood pilot - next steps

Marissa — thanks for the thread. Quick action items for finance/legal ops: 

- Can you produce a sample invoice populated with ACME billing address + placeholder for PO (showing where PO will appear)? Include our remittance ACH and card instructions. Use sample_invoice_redwood.pdf as the template.
- Prepare W-9 and standard MSA (or redirect to our public MSA link) for Elena. Procurement prefers direct contracting, so Legal should be on standby for a standard SOW / MSA — I'll flag to Legal.
- Marketplace: hold for now; procurement prefers direct vendor contract as Elena said. We can revisit marketplace after pilot if they want ongoing subscription through AWS Marketplace.
- I'll join the billing ops call if Elena schedules.

I can also confirm we can accept PO + net30. Card payments are supported but not preferred for initial pilots > $5k.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Invoice & billing details for Redwood pilot - next steps

Hi Elena — perfect, thanks for the clarity. Attached are: (1) a sample invoice pre-filled with ACME billing address and placeholder PO field, (2) our W-9, and (3) a completed vendor onboarding form (I filled out the supplier portal section).

Summary of agreed items / next steps:
- Procurement path: ACME will onboard Redwood as a vendor and issue a PO in format ACME-PO-YYYY-NNNN.
- Terms: Net 30 accepted for the pilot.
- Invoice routing: Invoices to be sent to payables@acme.com and cc procurement@acme.com. Include PO number in the invoice header and on each line.
- Billing address / tax: Using the ACME billing address and Tax ID you provided.
- Marketplace: Not required now; we will follow direct vendor path.
- Vendor docs: Attached W-9 and completed sections of the onboarding form. Please confirm if anything else is needed for vendor setup.

If you prefer, we can schedule a 15 minute billing ops call tomorrow at 11am PT — Vivek and I will join to finalize vendor fields and confirm remittance instructions. Would that work for your supplier coordinator?

Thanks again — I'll mark the HubSpot deal RDW-202605-ACME-01 as procurement engaged and pending PO.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
